note: Founded 2011 by Paul Biggar and Allen Rohner; CEO Jim Rose. Acquired Distiller (2014), Vamp (2021), and Ponicode (2022). Laid off ~17% of workforce (~100 employees) in December 2022. Founder Paul Biggar was removed from the board in December 2023, which he alleges was retaliation for a pro-Palestinian blog post. Last known valuation $1.7B (2021, Series F).
